PlanApproved is NEVER durably committed (no admissible daemon chain contains plan.approve; runs durably stay lifecycle PLAN_REVIEW with approvedHashes null — planning-services.ts:106-158, planning-authority-finalize-ingress.ts:63-75, planning-run-reducer.ts:66-68). The sealed authority bodies live at planning-authority/<runId> (13-key PlanningAuthorityBodiesSealed + 6-key PlanningAuthorityEnvelopeSealed), so runId→bodies is exact — but NO current-approved fact yields runId: GoalState.planningRunRef is caller-supplied at goal.create, never re-verified at approval, and goes stale after plan.revise (names the REJECTED predecessor — planning-run-submission.ts:191-200). DELIVERABLE: at approval.decide/activation time, verify (runId's durable run: lifecycle===PLAN_REVIEW, state.submissionHash===record.exactRevisionHash, state.graphRevisionRef===the caller's graphRevisionRef — refuse with exact codes on each mismatch, naming which check refused) and durably record in the GoalExecutionEnabled activation witness: runId, authorityRef (planning-authority/<runId>), bodiesDigest, envelopeDigest. ADDITIVE-SCHEMA HAZARD: measure every witness consumer and codec before adding keys — readApprovedNodeScope (goals/goal-close-prerequisite.ts:66-97) reads the witness with its own admission, and any exact-key gate on the event payload refuses new keys until updated; coordinate, never fork the witness shape. CONSUMERS: task-47b2dbc6 (blocked on this row — its readers join goal→runId→bodies through this witness) then c320c34a's matrix. NOT IN SCOPE: the readers themselves; run-multiplicity write-side prevention (detect-side stays SPLIT_BRAIN-style, recorded for a future row).
